title: 真实redis-check-aof尾损修复：只修副本，核对批准截断点后隔离恢复
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Redis官方文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现 repair_copy(source,destination,approved_bytes)。source为本题私有Redis7.2单个增量AOF的完整证据副本，末尾故意不完整；先用真实redis-check-aof只读检查确认需修复。approved_bytes为明确批准保留的正整数字节数且拒绝bool，必须小于原长度。只在临时副本执行redis-check-aof --fix并确认，验证修复后恰为批准长度、原始前缀字节和再次官方检查成功，才以0600原子发布不存在的destination。保留原文件字节，失败不发布或覆盖旧工件，清理临时文件；返回前后长度和修复SHA256。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Redis7.2增量AOF不完整尾部及官方工具，连同原manifest/base在独立实例恢复；截断损失边界由可信调用方批准。不修唯一原件，不验证任意中部损坏、所有版本或生产切换。
rubric: 识别题设具体根因并提供对应证据
给出可观察的验收结果并说明必要边界

conversion.original_title: 异常断电后AOF尾部不完整导致加载告警或失败，怎样保留证据并恢复？

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,secrets,subprocess,shutil,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from redis_persistence_native import AOFRedis,await_aof
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with AOFRedis() as server,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 key='balance:'+secrets.token_hex(8);value=secrets.token_hex(20);server.command('SET',key,value);await_aof(server.command);server.stop()
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);broken=root/'broken';shutil.copytree(server.root/'appendonlydir',broken)
 manifest=(broken/'appendonly.aof.manifest').read_text();increments=[line.split()[1] for line in manifest.splitlines() if line.split()[-1]=='i'];assert len(increments)==1
 source=broken/increments[0];valid=source.read_bytes();source.write_bytes(valid+b'*3\r\n$3\r\nSET\r\n$9\r\nincomplete')
 evidence=source.read_bytes();assert subprocess.run(['redis-check-aof',str(source)],capture_output=True).returncode!=0
 print('NATIVE_FAULT_REPRODUCED:incomplete-AOF-tail',flush=True)
 clean=root/'clean';shutil.copytree(broken,clean);destination=clean/source.name;destination.unlink()
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:repair_copy',flush=True)
 try:receipt=task.repair_copy(source,destination,len(valid))
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved copy repair did not complete') from error
 assert source.is_file() and source.read_bytes()==evidence,'only original AOF was modified or removed'
 assert destination.read_bytes()==valid and receipt=={'before_bytes':len(evidence),'after_bytes':len(valid),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(valid).hexdigest()}
 assert subprocess.run(['redis-check-aof',str(destination)],capture_output=True).returncode==0
 with AOFRedis(restore=clean) as restored:assert restored.command('GET',key)==value,'isolated Redis could not recover verified prefix'
 denied=root/'unapproved'
 try:task.repair_copy(source,denied,len(valid)-1)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('unapproved loss boundary accepted')
 assert not denied.exists() and source.read_bytes()==evidence and not list(root.glob('.aof-repair-*'))
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
